question: Who won the men’s singles title at the 2025 French Open, held in June 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Carlos Alcaraz**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Carlos Alcaraz** won the **Men’s Singles title** at the **2025 French Open**, held in **June 2025**. This victory solidified his position as one of the top players in men’s tennis.
 
• The French Open, also known as **Roland-Garros**, is one of the four **Grand Slam tennis tournaments** and is played on **clay courts**.
 
• **Carlos Alcaraz**, hailing from **Spain**, is known for his exceptional skill on clay courts, a surface that has historically favored players with strong baseline games and stamina.
 
• By defeating top players in the tournament, Alcaraz showcased his **powerful groundstrokes, agility, and mental toughness**, which are critical on the demanding clay surface.
 
• This win marked another milestone in Alcaraz’s career, further establishing him as the next dominant player in the post-"Big Three" era of tennis.
